name: Reminders
summary: Ask your assistant to remind you of something at a time you choose. It shows as a notification, even when the app is closed.

tools.name: reminder.add
tools.description: Sets a reminder that shows as a notification on the phone at the chosen time, even when Pocketnode is closed. Give EXACTLY ONE of: `at` (the owner's local date and time, like 2026-10-20T15:00), `in_minutes`, or `time` (a clock time like 09:00, only together with `repeat`; the phone picks the next date itself). For anything that repeats daily, weekly or on weekdays, use `time` and `repeat`. A reminder happens once unless the owner used a word like every, daily, weekly, each or weekdays: never add `repeat` on your own. Use this when the owner says remind me, and use the alarm tool only when they ask for an alarm.

text.description: What to remind the owner about, in a few words

time.description: Clock time HH:mm, only with repeat. The phone starts it at the next such time.

repeat.description: Leave out unless the owner asked for it to repeat (every day, each week, weekdays). Weekdays means Monday to Friday.

tools.name: reminder.list
tools.description: Lists the reminders waiting to go off, with their ids and times.

tools.name: reminder.cancel
tools.description: Cancels a reminder by its id (use reminder.list to find it).
